summary: Triggers an action on the current page (save, submit, open a dialog). LinkButton looks the same but is a real link for navigation.
whenToUse: Actions that change data or state: saving, submitting a form, opening an overlay.
One primary action per visual area; use secondary, outline, or ghost for the others.
whenNotToUse: To navigate to another page: use LinkButton or Link.
For a persistent on/off state: use Toggle or Switch.
For icon-only buttons without text: use IconButton with an accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and padding; the theme density scales all sizes.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Activation from mouse, touch, keyboard, and screen readers.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Loading state: shows a spinner and blocks presses, but keeps focus and announces the wait.

props.name: type
props.description: Native type; use submit in forms.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Takes up the full available width.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class; can depend on state (isHovered, isPressed, isFocusVisible…).

inherits: All props of the react-aria-components Button (onPressStart, onHoverChange, form, name, value, autoFocus…) and global DOM attributes, including data-* and aria-*.
accessibility: Always renders a <button> element (or <a> for LinkButton): no clickable divs.
In the pending state the button stays focusable and the wait is announced to screen readers.
Keyboard focus shows a high-contrast ring (data-focus-visible), including in forced-colors mode.
The minimum height meets the 24×24 CSS px target size (WCAG 2.5.8); in comfortable density it is 40 px.
responsive: Text does not wrap: use short labels or fullWidth on mobile.
On touch devices the minimum target area stays adequate even with size="sm".
customization: Radius: radius.md token (can be overridden in createTheme via tokens).
commonMistakes: Using onClick: prefer onPress, which handles touch and keyboard consistently.
Using Button with a handler that sets window.location: use LinkButton.

examples.title: Async action
examples.description: The pending state is controlled by the consumer; here the wait is simulated with a local timer.
